items.title: Suno-made track 'The Adult I Dreamed Of' is a hit in South Korea
items.excerpt: Creator Meomuru wrote the lyrics and generated the music with Suno; the AI-tagged track hit No.3 on Melon's Top 100, No.10 on Spotify's South Korea daily Top 50 and No.2 on YouTube's weekly Korean chart with 3.2m views.

items.title: Deezer lets users hide AI music; Playhead generates signal chains for producers
items.excerpt: Playhead (playhead.fm, founder Shelby Stevens) works in any DAW: producers describe a sound in plain text and its AI builds an editable DSP effects chain for the stem, without generating or training on the artist's audio. (Deezer half already covered 10-14; pitch the Playhead angle.)

items.title: Audiotool reveals six winners from its 'Let's Build!' hackathon
items.excerpt: Audiotool's hackathon winners include Pocket Producer, an AI agent for music producers, and an AI A&R Assistant that analyses tracks, alongside non-AI tools like Score IO and an Ableton converter. AI is only part of the story.

items.title: Rocketship Maps A Song's Listeners Before Release For Free
items.excerpt: Rocketship is a new free AI platform that examines 80+ audio, lyric and contextual factors in an unreleased track to profile its likely audience, giving indie artists label-style targeting data before release.

items.title: What Should Music Awards Recognize in the Age of AI?
items.excerpt: An opinion piece arguing that awards should judge the human creative decisions behind AI-assisted work, and that awards bodies need transparency rules on AI use.

items.title: A$AP Rocky Has a Very Diplomatic Stance on AI in Music: 'Who Am I to Say What's Standard'
items.excerpt: A$AP Rocky gave his view on the growing use of AI in music, declining to condemn it: 'Who am I to say what's standard.' An artist opinion, not a product or ruling.

items.title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn Slammed for 'Cringe' AI Video of Her as Kendrick Lamar Performing 'Not Like Us' at Super Bowl
items.excerpt: U.S. Sen. Marsha Blackburn was criticised on social media for posting an AI video of herself performing Kendrick Lamar's "Not Like Us" at the Super Bowl. The item is about AI music likeness and deepfakes.

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo Clarifies AI Stance Following 'Invasive' Tech Investor Dating Rumors: 'Absolutely No'
items.excerpt: Olivia Rodrigo clarified her stance on AI ('Absolutely No') and responded to rumours that she was dating an AI tech investor. This is a celebrity opinion item.

items.title: Nobody is safe from celebrity AI deepfakes
items.excerpt: A Verge report finds Instagram full of AI deepfakes of celebrities including Taylor Swift. Meta doesn't require labels on AI-generated still images, which matters for artists' likeness rights.

items.title: MUSEBENCH: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Music Detection and Artifact Analysis
items.excerpt: A 361K-track benchmark (human, Suno/Udio and eight other generators, human-AI co-creations, perturbed variants) tests 11 AI-music detectors. It identifies telltale artifacts such as non-idiomatic harmony, upsampling spectral periodicities and physically impossible performances.

items.title: Point-and-Play: Instrument Timbre Cloning from Music Mixtures
items.excerpt: A system that clones a cued instrument's timbre straight from a fully mixed recording, skipping stem separation, and plays it at new pitches and velocities. It beats separate-then-clone baselines.

items.title: FLOMSS: Generative Music Source Separation by Flow Matching
items.excerpt: Applies flow-matching generative modelling to four-stem (vocals, bass, drums, other) full-band stereo separation, with competitive objective and listening-test results on MUSDB18-HQ; demo available.
